description: This file defines the Cart class within the Opencart e-commerce system. The class manages shopping cart functionalities including adding, removing, updating products, calculating totals, taxes, weight, and handling subscriptions and options.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Encapsulates shopping cart operations such as product management, calculating totals, and handling subscriptions, options, and stock status within the Opencart system.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products currently in the cart, populating detailed information including options, pricing, stock status, and subscriptions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a product with specified options and subscription plan to the cart, or updates quantity if already present.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item by its cart ID.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks whether a specific cart item exists by its cart ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by its cart ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all products in the cart that are subscription-based.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Calculates the total weight of products in the cart, considering weight class conversions.

methods.name: getSubTotal
methods.description: Calculates the subtotal of the products in the cart before taxes and discounts.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Calculates applicable taxes for products in the cart based on their tax class.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price including taxes for all products in the cart.

methods.name: countProducts
methods.description: Returns the total number of products across all cart items.

methods.name: hasProducts
methods.description: Checks if there are any products in the cart.

methods.name: hasSubscription
methods.description: Checks if there are any subscription products in the cart.

methods.name: hasStock
methods.description: Verifies if all products in the cart are in stock.

methods.name: hasMinimum
methods.description: Checks whether all products meet their minimum order quantities.

methods.name: hasShipping
methods.description: Checks if any product in the cart requires shipping.

methods.name: hasDownload
methods.description: Checks if any product in the cart includes downloadable items.
